objective: Assess commit c2f4433 (the Kimi for Coding provider mapping, readiness and catalog checks) for security issues around credentials, command execution and supply-chain pinning.
scope: Diff: /home/user/holyagent-notes/kimi-provider.diff; worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-provider. Requirements in /home/user/holyagent-notes/intent-kimi-provider.txt: HolyAgent never calls provider URLs, never reads auth.json, never uses pi auth print-api-key or print-bearer-token; readiness runs pi auth check --provider <id> --json; the provider package is pinned (pi-provider-kimi-code@0.6.13).
constraints: Read-only: no edits and no version-control writes.
Report in under 350 words; start each evidence line with the exact criterion text, a colon, then the support.

criteria.text: No credential is read, printed, logged or passed on, and no provider URL is called
The readiness and catalog commands take fixed arguments with no injection from config or catalog output
The provider package source is pinned to an exact version

result:
result: No credential, injection or pinning blocker in c2f4433. One non-blocking pinning gap: `piPackages` still returns the bare, unpinned package name.

The built-in `/security-review` could not run. Its `git diff origin/HEAD...` failed with an unknown revision, and the review session has no shell. I reviewed `/home/user/holyagent-notes/kimi-provider.diff` by reading it and the worktree `/home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-provider`. Evidence is read-only; I ran no checks.

blockers: none

notes:
- **Pinning gap (suspicion).** `providerSource()` returns `npm:pi-provider-kimi-code@0.6.13`, an exact pin. `piPackages()` in `packages/runtime/src/config/packages.ts` returns the bare `pi-provider-kimi-code` (`PROVIDERS[provider].package`, asserted by `packages.test.ts`). Nothing in this commit consumes either function. A future launcher that installs from `piPackages` would take an unpinned latest from npm, so it should use `providerSource`. The other `FEATURE_PACKAGES` entries and `pi-web-kit` were already unpinned before this commit and are out of scope here.
- **Model id (future risk).** `ModelId` is `Schema.NonEmptyString`, so a user config can hold any string, including whitespace or `:`. It reaches only `spec`, which starts with `kimi-coding/`, so it cannot begin with `-`. Nothing launches Pi with it yet. The launcher must pass it as one argv element and never interpolate it into a shell string.
- **Catalog output.** `parseModelCatalog` output is only compared with the route table. It is never passed to a command or path.
- **Error text.** Readiness and catalog errors carry at most 400 characters of Pi's stdout or stderr. Pi's `auth check --json` prints status and reason only (per the fixtures), so no secret is expected there.
- **Docs wording.** The docs and a test title say "0.6 line" although the pin is exact. This is cosmetic.

Found sound:
- Both Pi commands use literal argv: `pi auth check --provider <id> --json` and `pi --list-models`. `<id>` is `PROVIDERS[...].id`, a static `kimi-coding`, and no config value reaches argv.
- The runner is the Bun Shell with `$\`${command} ${args}\``, which escapes each argv element. The tests assert the exact calls.
- There is no call to `auth.json`, `print-api-key` or `print-bearer-token`. The only matches in the worktree are docs prohibiting them.
- No `fetch` or provider URL appears in the new code.
- `providerEnv` sets only `KIMI_CODE_REGION=global`, a constant.

evidence:
- No credential is read, printed, logged or passed on, and no provider URL is called: Met. `packages/runtime/src/pi/readiness.ts` and `catalog.ts` only run `pi auth check` and `pi --list-models`. A repo-wide grep finds no `auth.json`, `print-*` or HTTP use outside docs.
- The readiness and catalog commands take fixed arguments with no injection from config or catalog output: Met. `readiness.ts:70` uses `["auth","check","--provider",id,"--json"]` with a static id, and `catalog.ts:65` uses `["--list-models"]`. `shell.ts:112` escapes argv.
- The provider package source is pinned to an exact version: Met for `providerSource` (`provider.ts:68-71`, `0.6.13`, asserted in `provider.test.ts`). The `piPackages` caveat is in notes.
- diff-file: `/home/user/holyagent-notes/kimi-provider.diff`

acceptance.rationale: No credential use, fixed argv, exact providerSource pin; piPackages gap carried to the repair
